title: From molecular architecture to environmental action: a new palladium-based perovskite catalyst as a cathodic modifier for electro-Fenton degradation
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,30326-30338
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA03275J, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Houyem Khlifi, Ahlem Guesmi, Nejmeddine Rabaaoui, Mourad Cherif, Noureddine Mhadhbi, Wesam Abd El-Fattah, Naoufel Ben Hamadi, Houcine Naïli
The 1D Pd-based hybrid perovskite (C9H8N)[PdCl3(H2O)] was synthesized and employed as a cathodic modifier in an electro-Fenton/BDD system, enhancing H2O2 generation and Fe2+ cycling for effective paraquat mineralization and water purification.
